label: Luxury hotel
brief: A 24-room boutique hotel in a restored 18th-century palazzo in Lecce, southern Italy. Rooftop pool looking over the baroque old town, a restaurant run by a local chef, and a small spa in the old cisterns. Guests are couples from northern Europe and the US on a special trip. We want them to check availability and book direct instead of through Booking.com.

hero.headline: A timeless stay in Lecce’s heart
hero.subheadline: A 24‑room palazzo retreat with rooftop pool, spa in ancient cisterns, and a restaurant led by a local chef—where romance lingers long after checkout.

sections.heading: Quiet evenings, timeless days
paragraphs: As dusk settles over Lecce, the rooftop pool catches the last glow of the sun and the city sighs into crystal-clear night. Here, every moment invites you to linger, to listen, to feel the stone’s history beneath your fingertips.

In our restored 18th-century palazzo, intimacy is crafted into every corner. Rooms open to private terraces, dining tells a slow, local story, and your plans are designed around you—together two people who came to be still and simply be.

issues.reason: Testimonials exist but the strategy calls for credibility through local awards and chef credentials as well. Relying solely on guest stories misses one pillar of proof the blueprint intends to establish.
